components.provenance: Convergence-owned provider catalog for the founder-mandated Deep3D presentation substrate. Registration provides conformance ownership only and does not transfer canonical, scientific, simulation, identity, persistence or camera authority.
Founder-mandated V2.0 hierarchical rendering-space address and precision seam. It owns presentation coordinate transport only and cannot promote scientific/model truth.

Read-only Deep3D bridge from the existing V1X/V2X camera reference-frame authority into renderer SpatialAddress coordinates. It transforms presentation poses and emits continuity witnesses but owns no camera, selection, identity, history or simulation state.
Founder-mandated V2.0 GPU-neutral semantic RenderPacket/RenderScene contract. Packets preserve upstream identity and provenance; GPU resources remain disposable presentation state.

Environment and loss-recovery selector for interchangeable Deep3D GPU backends. WebGPU is preferred only in supported secure contexts; WebGL2 is mandatory for direct-file execution and is the governed WebGPU fallback. Canvas spatial fallback is forbidden.
Existing bounded WebGPU presentation helper adopted by Deep3D for exact buffer ownership and device-loss invalidation. It has no semantic-state access and does not replace the WebGL2 baseline.

WebGPU Deep3D presentation backend over the same RenderScene semantics as WebGL2. It encodes real GPU draw commands with bounded buffer ownership, external camera matrices, semantic scene fingerprints and fail-closed device loss; it remains non-primary until real-browser evidence closes the gate.

Deep3D-to-V2X-13 WebGL2 adapter. It consumes camera-relative presentation geometry and delegates GPU resources, replay and context-loss lifecycle to the existing strict V2X-13 pixel consumer. Unsupported packet families fail closed at this staged checkpoint.

System-first Deep3D migration adapter over the existing V1X-04 true-3D scene. Canonical entity identity is preserved while deterministic icosphere body geometry, orbit geometry and lighting cues remain explicitly presentation-only.

Convergence-owned production bridge that makes Deep3D WebGL2/V2X-13 the visible primary SYSTEM renderer while retaining the existing Canvas renderer only as an interaction/accessibility hit-target overlay. Camera, selection, scientific state, identity, persistence and history remain upstream authorities.
